findings.body: The new integration test waits for a warning whose message is `Usage event recording failed`, but this catch handler logs `Usage event dispatch failed`. When the test forces event persistence to fail, that assertion times out and the API test suite fails.
findings.title: Not done: failed join event integration test

findings.body: The completed-account check runs before the transaction and is never repeated after `lockCircleMembershipRows` acquires the shared lock. A change to account state between that request and membership creation can therefore pass the join. The required at-join account check needs to occur under the lock.
findings.title: Not done: Recheck the completed account under the join lock

findings.body: The branch adds optional-session behavior to the guard but adds or changes no test under the required `apps/api/src/modules/sessions/**/*.spec.ts` path. In particular, the new path that treats an unauthorized cookie as signed out has no changed guard spec.
findings.title: Not done: optional-session guard spec

findings.body: The branch adds the preview and join service but adds or changes no test under the required `apps/api/src/modules/circles/join/**/*.spec.ts` path. The new integration file does not satisfy that separately named test path.
findings.title: Not done: join-service spec

findings.body: This new Forge task-status file is outside the permitted paths and supplies no code, API contract, or test needed for the invite work. It should be omitted from this branch.
